enrichment.summary: Configures a Conditional Access policy to enforce access only for compliant devices and require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication methods for all applications.
enrichment.rationale: Ensures that only secure, compliant devices can access organisational resources and minimises the risk of credential theft through the use of phishing-resistant authentication methods.
prerequisites: Phishing-resistant authentication methods configured (e.g., FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business)
